integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by two independent complete simplex enumerations, a globally checked acyclic face-poset matching, exact signed integral Morse-boundary elimination, and direct homology cross-checks over three prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the single graph L_3=P_3 square K_2 and does not assert a formula for all ladder graphs.
Originality is relative to the inspected primary literature and scientific-index searches; a differently indexed prior computation remains possible.
title: The three-rung ladder Morse complex is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
